errors.evidence: The chart legend clearly indicates there are four models (DNN-HMM, TDNN-HMM, LSTM-HMM, End-to-End), not five.
The image shows a single grouped bar chart, which contains five groups of bars. It is not five separate histograms.

errors.text_span: LSTM-HMM (黄色) 和 End-to-End (金黄色)
errors.evidence: According to the legend, LSTM-HMM is represented by the grey bars, and End-to-End is represented by the yellow bars. The description incorrectly maps LSTM-HMM to yellow and misses the grey category entirely.

errors.text_span: Test1 的蓝色柱状图大约 22% 左右，橙色柱状图大约 28% 左右，黄色柱状图大约 25% 左右，金黄色柱状图大约 31% 左右。
errors.evidence: The values for Test1 are approximately: DNN-HMM (blue) ~22%, TDNN-HMM (orange) ~30.5%, LSTM-HMM (grey) ~10.5%, and End-to-End (yellow) ~12.5%. The description's values for the orange, yellow, and "golden yellow" bars are all incorrect. For example, the orange bar is over 30%, not 28%.

errors.text_span: Test2 的蓝色柱状图大约 21% 左右，橙色柱状图大约 26% 左右，黄色柱状图大约 23% 左右，金黄色柱状图大约 29% 左右。

errors.text_span: 所有五个柱状图都按垂直顺序排列，从矮到高。
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The bars within each group are not sorted by height. For example, in Test1, the bar heights are approximately 22%, 30.5%, 10.5%, and 12.5%, which is not a sorted order.
